name: emergent-complexity curated sources
note: Curated with AnySearch for the studio source pool. Add, remove, or extend per project; the studio copies this pack into a project's ei-sources.json on first use.

sources.title: Context Rot: How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance
sources.note: 18 models: performance degrades with input length even on trivial tasks; NIAH overestimates long-context ability. Evidence for keeping working context small.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents (Anthropic)
sources.note: Compaction, structured note-taking, sub-agent architectures, just-in-time retrieval; attention budget is finite.

sources.title: Agentic Context Compression (ACC)
sources.note: Transcript replay and retrieval memory grow unbounded and poison state; bounded internal state + verification gate before commitment reduces drift and hallucination.

sources.title: MemMachine: ground-truth-preserving agent memory
sources.note: Memory architectures that keep an auditable ground truth separate from inferred memory.

sources.title: A Survey of Memory in LLM Agents
sources.note: Representations, operations, and open problems of agent memory.

sources.title: AGENTS.md — a simple open format for agent instructions
sources.note: Durable facts and decisions, progressive disclosure, no chronological transcripts, handoff files.

sources.title: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites (MAP-Elites)
sources.note: Descriptor-grid archive: keep the best solution per cell, illuminate the space instead of chasing one objective.

sources.title: Abandoning Objectives: Evolution Through the Search for Novelty Alone
sources.note: Novelty search outperforms objective-driven search on deceptive problems; archive-level novelty is the real driver.

sources.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models (FunSearch)
sources.note: LLM proposes, evaluator scores, archive retains; evolutionary program search with an external verifier.

sources.title: AlphaEvolve: a Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms
sources.note: Distributed evolutionary search over programs with automated evaluators.

sources.title: Open-Endedness is Essential for Artificial Superhuman Intelligence
sources.note: Why continual innovation requires open-ended search rather than fixed objectives.

sources.title: POET: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer
sources.note: Co-evolving environments and solutions; stepping stones emerge without explicit objectives.

sources.title: The AI Scientist
sources.note: End-to-end automated research loop: idea, experiment, write-up, review.

sources.title: Voyager: an open-ended embodied agent with LLMs
sources.note: Skill library growth with automatic curriculum — durable capability accumulation.

sources.title: Darwin Gödel Machine
sources.note: Self-modifying agents with an archive of variants and empirical selection.

sources.title: Managing Diversity and Many Objectives in Evolutionary Design
sources.note: Extending MAP-Elites to many objectives while preserving diversity.

sources.title: Parsimony in genetic programming / bloat control
sources.note: Size grows while fitness stalls; parsimony pressure is the countermeasure (P11 in the skill).

sources.title: Prigogine Nobel lecture: dissipative structures
sources.note: Order emerges far from equilibrium only with sustained fluctuation and dissipation.

sources.title: The Edge of Chaos (self-organisation and selection)
sources.note: Computation at the boundary between order and chaos; selection and self-organisation coupled.

sources.title: LLM-Driven Evolutionary Program Search: From FunSearch to Automated Scientific Discovery
sources.note: Survey of LLM+EA loops: search blindness in EAs vs logical illusion in LLMs; how the combination addresses both.
